item.title: Daily Minute — September 17, 2026
item.description: NOW it is given you to heal and teach, to make what will be NOW.As yet it is NOT now. The Son of God believes that he is lost in guilt, alone in a dark world where pain is pressing everywhere upon him from WITHOUT.
